data: Own Wachstube and Nera die Quartiermeisterin pages in the demo graph; no local directory granted.
roomText: Nera verlangt ihren ausstehenden Sold. Noch klären: Was weiß sie über den Keller? NSC: [[Nera die Quartiermeisterin]]
initialNote: Nera kennt den Zugang zum Keller.
editedNote: Nera kennt den Zugang zum Keller. Sie fordert Sold, bevor sie den Keller erwähnt.

actions.action: Ordinary click on Nera from Wachstube
actions.observed: Main page changed to Nera die Quartiermeisterin; room appeared under 1 Linked Reference.

actions.action: Return to Wachstube via recent pages, Shift+click Nera
actions.observed: Wachstube remained the main page; Nera opened in the right sidebar.

actions.action: Click note block in sidebar, edit motive, Escape
actions.observed: Updated motive visible in sidebar while original room text remained visible in main page.

friction: Ordinary click leaves the room. The simultaneous view requires Shift+click; the initial tutorial explains this gesture.
persistenceLimit: The demo explicitly states changes are not saved until a local directory is opened. No reload, disk persistence or desktop parity is claimed.
